name: Roofing
summary: Roof inspections, repairs, full replacement, storm-damage restoration and emergency protection for residential and commercial properties.

faqs.question: How do I know whether my roof needs repair or replacement?
faqs.answer: The decision depends on the roof age, extent of damage, active leaks, condition of the shingles and whether repairs can provide a durable result.

faqs.question: Can hail damage be present without an active leak?
faqs.answer: Yes. Hail can damage shingles, flashing, vents and soft metals before water enters the building, so an inspection is important after a severe storm.
